approaches.hypothesis: A start-time, repository-resolved ordered target declaration prevents prose-reading validators while supporting one atom that validates multiple fields.
approaches.implementation: Require contract_surface; resolve every target against module constants; require a code-controlled owner choice for prose; bind the declaration and adopted waiver statement through experiment, status, and promotion.
approaches.predicted_tradeoff: Every launcher must preserve the declaration and prose validation needs one informed owner choice between two fixed meanings.

approaches.hypothesis: The existing outcome and allowed paths give atom authors enough guidance without another machine-readable boundary.
approaches.implementation: Keep the pre-Atom controller unchanged and rely on authors and reviewers to notice prose-reading validation.
approaches.predicted_tradeoff: No request migration, but the same validation class remains mechanically admissible.

criteria: the two recorded prose targets refuse before a run is created without a waiver
the two recorded structured validators start against the real Step 12 schema
the card validator declares both month and phase in order
a misspelling names the failed path and available keys
the owner sees fixed meanings, chooses only waive or decline, and an accepted choice preserves the full adopted statement in status
the real launcher preserves declarations and round three stops only on proof-order
record-experiment stores its named static key evidence
